zh: 销售现场查资料慢|产品问题太专业，客服无法独立回答|销售材料千篇一律，缺少针对性
历史方案分散，资料难以复用|每份初稿耗时，反复核对参数|关键条款容易遗漏，审核压力大
员工反复问同样的问题|知识更新后，旧答案仍在传播|权限不同，资料不能随意开放
查一个数字，要等 IT 导数|指标口径不统一，结果难核对|业务人员不会 SQL，无法自助分析
en: Product information takes too long to find|Support cannot answer specialist questions|Sales material lacks relevance
Past proposals are scattered|Drafting and parameter checks take days|Critical requirements get missed
Employees ask the same questions repeatedly|Old answers persist after policy updates|Different roles need different access
Every query goes through the IT queue|Inconsistent metrics make results hard to trust|Business users cannot write SQL

how_the_system_handles.en: How the system handles a task

related_system_and_project.zh: 查看相关系统与项目结果

can_it_connect_to.zh: 可以接入我们已有的系统吗？
can_it_connect_to.en: Can it connect to our existing systems?

yes_the_assessment_covers.zh: 可以。评估阶段会确认数据来源、接口和权限，优先使用现有数据库、文档与业务系统。
yes_the_assessment_covers.en: Yes. The assessment covers data sources, interfaces and permissions, starting with the systems and documents you already use.

how_do_you_make.zh: 如何保证答案和结果可靠？
how_do_you_make.en: How do you make results reliable?

we_use_your_own.zh: 使用企业自己的资料，结合引用溯源、规则校验和人工复核点。无法确认的任务交还业务负责人处理。
we_use_your_own.en: We use your own sources, citations, validation rules and human review. Uncertain tasks return to a business owner.

when_can_we_try.en: When can we try a first version?
